name: Product detail
description: The product page's buy box: gallery, title, price, rating, variant pickers, quantity, add to cart, honest stock status, delivery notes and description tabs, plus a quick-add bar on narrow widths.

fields.name: Product
fields.helpText: Leave empty on a product template — the route supplies it.
fields.description: Pick one by hand for a featured-product landing section.

fields.name: Variant
fields.helpText: gallery-left is the default. gallery-right mirrors the two columns visually; the reading order stays gallery then information.

fields.name: Show rating
fields.helpText: Hidden anyway when the product has fewer than 3 reviews.

fields.name: Show wishlist
fields.helpText: Off: Add to cart fills the row alone.

fields.name: Low stock threshold
fields.helpText: "Only N left" shows only when real inventory is at or below this number. off never shows it.

fields.name: Perks
fields.helpText: Delivery and returns notes under the buy button. 2 work best.

fields.name: Text
fields.helpText: One line. Delivery dates come from the shipping API, so keep this general.

fields.name: Tabs
fields.helpText: Details, Shipping and Returns by default.

fields.name: Body
fields.helpText: Paragraphs, lists, bold and links. The Details tab usually repeats the product description.

fields.name: Size guide label
fields.helpText: Shows the link next to the Size legend. Needs a link URL too.

fields.name: Quick add bar
fields.helpText: Shows the quick-add bar below 48rem once the main button has scrolled away.

fields.name: Show category trail
fields.helpText: Turn it off when the page already has a Breadcrumbs block, so the trail never shows twice.
